what: UK buyer reports being charged $175 in March 2025 without prior notification, then $361.70 subsequently, and escalated to PayPal's legal team, the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA), and Action Fraud
verbatim_snippet: "I am writing this to warn others about Domestika's deceptive billing practices. What started as a small, one-off purchase has turned into a nightmare of unauthorized, high-value charges. In March 2025, I was charged $175 without any prior notification, renewal reminder, or receipt. Most recently, they hit my account for a staggering $361.70—a massive \"price hike\" that was also taken without consent or notice."
